description: Query Overture Maps global Places dataset (88M+ POIs merged from Meta, Microsoft, Foursquare, and others) directly via GeoParquet range requests. Returns rich commercial POI metadata often missing in OSM: existence confidence scores (0-1), brand & Wikidata IDs, websites, phones, emails, socials, structured addresses, operating status, taxonomy categories, and contributing data sources. Either 'location' or 'bbox' is required.

bbox.description: Bounding box ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2', WKT, GeoJSON) or single point ('lat,lng'). Required if location is omitted.

category.description: Overture Maps category filter matched against basic_category and taxonomy segments (e.g., 'coffee_shop', 'restaurant', 'pharmacy', 'hotel', 'grocery_store').

count_only.description: If true, returns only aggregate counts and category_counts breakdown without individual place records. Defaults to false.

include_closed.description: Whether to include places marked operating_status='permanently_closed'. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum places to return per page (default 25, max 100). Ignored when count_only is true.

location.description: Location name to geocode and search within (e.g., 'Times Square, New York'). Combine with radius_meters for circular search or use_area_boundary for strict polygon filtering. Required if bbox is omitted.

min_confidence.description: Minimum Overture existence confidence score in [0, 1] (e.g., 0.7). Defaults to 0.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset into matched places (default 0).

query.description: Case-insensitive text filter matched across place name, brand, category, and address (e.g., 'Starbucks', 'ramen').

radius_meters.description: Search radius in meters around the location/point center. Defaults to 500 when a single point bbox is provided without radius_meters.

sort_by.description: Sort order for returned places: 'distance' (nearest to center, default) or 'confidence' (highest confidence first).

use_area_boundary.description: When true with 'location' (and without radius_meters), clips places strictly to the geocoded area polygon instead of its rectangular bounding box. Defaults to false.

name: search_places

complete.description: True if the full spatial query completed and either all results are returned or total count is exact

count.description: Total number of matching places before pagination

has_more.description: True if additional pages exist beyond offset + returned_count

matched_place.description: Geocoded place name (when location is used)

next_offset.description: Next pagination offset if has_more is true, else null

release.description: Overture Maps STAC release version queried (e.g., '2026-10-21.0')

returned_count.description: Number of places returned in this response

share_url.description: Shareable interactive map URL showing matched places

truncated.description: True if fewer than all matched places were returned
